name: east-blue-mill
relations: Long roof ridge runs away from nearly face-on front gable
Rotor cross stands in front of the ridge on an attached timber bearing
Small grey roofed projection attaches to lower right front wall
Neighboring barn overlaps the bottom right; neighboring house overlaps the upper right
completion: Closed walls and gables, solid roof slabs, full rear framing and entrance, solid connected rotor and axle; no external scenery.
